BiblicalUsage: Peles is a balance, the scales that weigh. Isaiah asks who weighed the mountains in scales and the hills in a balance — God alone, in the hollow of His hand. Proverbs says a just weight and balance are the LORD's, and all the weights of the bag are His work.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that God's scales never lie: He weighs the mountains and He weighs my heart with the same just hand.
